title: PostgreSQL (PGlite): живой SQL-запрос с GROUP BY, COUNT и SUM
learn: Написание аналитического SQL-запроса, который реально исполняется движком PostgreSQL (PGlite) на таблице orders.
prompt: Напиши SQL-запрос для PostgreSQL: выбери `status`, `COUNT(*) AS total_count` и `SUM(amount) AS total_amount` из таблицы `orders`, где `amount > 0`, сгруппируй по `status` (`GROUP BY status`) и отсортируй по `total_amount DESC`.
specs: Запрос реально выполняется в движке PostgreSQL (PGlite) на таблице orders(id, status, amount)
Используй SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM orders WHERE amount > 0 GROUP BY status ORDER BY total_amount DESC;
starterJs:
-- Таблица: orders (id SERIAL, status TEXT, amount INTEGER)
SELECT

hints.text: Порядок секций в SQL: SELECT -> FROM -> WHERE -> GROUP BY -> ORDER BY.
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM orders WHERE amount > 0 GROUP BY status ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

codeChecks.name: Агрегации COUNT(*) AS total_count и SUM(amount) AS total_amount
codeChecks.expectedHint: COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(amount) AS total_amount

solution:
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(amount) AS total_amount
FROM orders
WHERE amount > 0
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;
